The random names floating in the map animation are decorative; use the actual battle records to check who you fought. A repeated animation name alone does not prove that you fought the same defender again.

label: Info box · 6 appointment actions per day. Officer appointments and transferring league leadership share th
default: 6 appointment actions per day. Officer appointments and transferring league leadership share this limit. Removing a title completely does not consume an action. The in-game rules also describe possible automatic leadership transfer after more than 24 hours of inactivity.

default: Follow the election rules shown during preparation. The in-game descriptions cover a highest-Combat-Power selection and a voting variant. Higher power can affect selection or candidate eligibility to become Goldrush League Leader.

default: Kills and daily attacks are separate counters. One attack can show several opponent fights. The client receives the daily counter from the server; these records do not establish whether every button press or every opponent encounter increments it. Do not assume 11 kills automatically means +20% exhaustion.

default: Attacker points and owner harvest are different rewards. Breaking a defense line can grant claim points to the attacking side. Damage also reduces the owner's harvest ratio. At zero defenders, the clam defense fails and the owner receives no harvest revenue.

default: Reward settlement info. See the in-game Goldrush screen for current daily and final rewards. Candy display can scale with the active schedule/account coefficient. Ranking brackets are alternatives, not cumulative milestones; attack and rally reward paths may differ.

default: “50× went farther for me” is an observation, not proof of better odds. Smaller multipliers offer more opportunities to stop near a target. Larger multipliers make progress in fewer, larger steps.
